disabled.downstream: Consumer builds compare third-party projects with upstream gix releases. Brit's consumer is the elohim monorepo, which attests its submodule pin.

macos-aarch64.reason: Hosted macOS ARM is suspended for this repository; macOS coverage stays on Intel.

inherited-ci.meaning: Brit's first-party jobs plus the inherited gitoxide checks its QA scheduler plans, each planned job declared required, deferred, replaced or disabled here. Legacy parity assertion failures remain observed outcomes, not parity acceptance. Excludes publication and native daily-driver acceptance.

native-daily-driver.reason: Automated authoring, transport, recovery and Unix installed-delivery slices have runnable probes. Exact-revision remote evidence, real released-version upgrade/rollback, installed epr integration and our own ongoing development across workspaces remain required; CI fixtures cannot establish operational acceptance.

git-compatibility.reason: Pinned vendor/git v2.54.0 is a comparison horizon; exhaustive behavior probes are not implemented.
